# Reference

Every concept of the approach, its type and definition, and the checks that hold it, generated from [ontology.md](../ontology.md) and [checks.md](../checks.md). Automatic checks are enforced by the tool; a check of review is given its verdict by a reviewer reading the change, and a check of run is carried out by an agent on the working product, because the tool cannot. The pages of this directory explain the parts; this page is what they refer to.

| Invariant | Not defined again  | `inv.retired-not-defined`     |                          | A retired ID has no definition row.                                                             |
| Invariant | Only in the log    | `inv.retired-only-in-log`     |                          | A retired ID appears nowhere but the decision log.                                              |
| Invariant | Replacement exists | `inv.replacement-exists`      |                          | The replacement of a retired ID has a definition row.                                           |

| `check.retired-id.unknown-replacement` | `inv.replacement-exists`  | a retired ID is replaced by an ID with no definition row | the check runs | it names both IDs and fails                    | auto  |

| Invariant | Changes of meaning decided    | `inv.meaning-change-decided`      |                                  | A change to meaning that rests on a choice has a decision entry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Invariant | Sourced from the first source | `inv.sourced-since-first`         |                                  | Once the log names a source, every entry accepted after that names its own.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Invariant | Departure well formed         | `inv.departure-well-formed`       |                                  | An entry with an Extends: or Overrides: line has Layer: process, and every such line names concepts of the approach that exist and, while the entry is in force, are not retired.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Action    | Answer a tentative entry      | `action.answer-tentative`         |                                  | The owner takes the recommendation, picks another option or drops the question: the entry is accepted, rewritten and accepted, or withdrawn; an accepted one names the answer on its Source: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Action    | Supersede a decision          | `action.supersede-decision`       |                                  | Write a new entry that replaces the old one whole and says why.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## Implementation row

| Kind      | Term                    | ID                                | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Implementation row      | `ent.implementation-row`          |                  | A claim that one or more concepts exist in the product, with the files and a note on what is partial.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Files                   | `field.implementation-row.files`  | text             | Paths of the files that realise the concept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Field     | Note                    | `field.implementation-row.note`   | text optional    | What is partial or missing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Relation  | Concepts                | `edge.implementation-row.concept` | refs ent.concept | The concepts the row claims; concepts realised in the same files may share a row.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Derived   | Named in code           | `derived.named-in-code`           |                  | The files that name a concept in an ont: comment: those of the implementation table and of the code directories the configuration lists; --coverage shows them, and the check lists implemented concepts that the files of their row do not name, as information unless the configuration requires names (inv.implemented-named). |
| Rule      | Code names its concepts | `rule.code-names-concepts`        |                  | Code that implements a concept names its ID next to it in a comment, // ont: inv.no-renew-when-held; a name is not an implementation, so the implementation table still says where a concept is built.                                                                                                                            |
| Rule      | Updated with the code   | `rule.table-with-code`            |                  | A change to behavior updates the implementation table in the same change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Rule      | Partial noted           | `rule.partial-noted`              |                  | The note of a partial row names the target concept that adds what is missing; no note means complete as far as the author knows.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Invariant | Code names resolve      | `inv.code-names-resolve`          |                  | Every ID that code names in an ont: comment is defined and not retired.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Files exist             | `inv.implementation-files-exist`  |                  | Every file the table names exists.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Invariant | Row is true             | `inv.implementation-true`         |                  | The files a row names do realise the concept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Invariant | Implemented is named    | `inv.implemented-named`           |                  | When the configuration sets codeNames.require, every implemented concept is named in an ont: comment in a file of its row, so a cleanup that deletes the name fails the check.                                                                                                                                                    |
| Invariant | Code has an owner       | `inv.code-has-owner`              |                  | When the configuration sets codeNames.owner, every file of the code directories names, in an ont: comment, at least one concept the ontology defines.                                                                                                                                                                             |

| Check                                          | Concepts                                     | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                         | WHEN                                | THEN                                                                                                                                  | Proof  |
| ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.implementation-row.missing-file`        | `inv.implementation-files-exist`             | a row names a file that does not exist                                                                                                                                        | the check runs                      | it names the file and fails                                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.grouped`             | `edge.implementation-row.concept`            | `edge.loan.item` and `edge.loan.member` share one row with one file                                                                                                           | the check runs                      | both count as implemented                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.code-name-unknown`   | `inv.code-names-resolve`                     | `app/library.mjs` names, in an `ont:` comment, an ID the ontology does not define, and elsewhere uses a property path that looks like an ID without such a comment            | the check runs                      | it names the ID and the file, and fails; the code without the comment is not read                                                     | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.code-name-retired`   | `inv.code-names-resolve`                     | `app/library.mjs` names `field.due-date`, which the ontology retired for `field.loan.due-date`                                                                                | the check runs                      | it names the ID and its replacement, and fails                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.unnamed-in-code`     | `derived.named-in-code`                      | `derived.queue-position` is implemented in `app/library.mjs`, and the file does not name it                                                                                   | the check runs, then `--coverage`   | it lists `derived.queue-position` as information and passes; `--coverage` shows, for each implemented concept, the files that name it | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.unnamed-required`    | `inv.implemented-named`                      | the configuration sets `codeNames.require`, and `app/library.mjs`, the file of the row of `derived.queue-position`, does not name it                                          | the check runs                      | it fails and names `derived.queue-position`                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.ownerless-required`  | `inv.code-has-owner`                         | the configuration sets `codeNames.owner`, and `app/format.mjs` in a code directory names no defined concept: no `ont:` comment, or one whose IDs the ontology does not define | the check runs                      | it fails and names the file; a file that names a defined concept, or that the directory's `match` leaves out, passes                  | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.ownerless-file`      | `inv.code-has-owner`                         | the configuration does not set `codeNames.owner`, and `app/format.mjs` in a code directory has no `ont:` comment                                                              | the check runs                      | it lists the file as information and passes                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.updated-with-code`   | `rule.table-with-code`, `rule.partial-noted` | a change to behavior                                                                                                                                                          | a reviewer reads it                 | the implementation table changed in the same change, and the note of a partial row names the target concept that adds what is missing | review |
| `check.implementation-row.true`                | `inv.implementation-true`                    | a row of the implementation table                                                                                                                                             | a reviewer opens the files it names | they realise the concept                                                                                                              | review |
| `check.implementation-row.code-names-concepts` | `rule.code-names-concepts`                   | code that implements a concept                                                                                                                                                | a reviewer reads it                 | an `ont:` comment next to the code names the concept                                                                                  | review |

## Divergence

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                              | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Divergence             | `ent.divergence`                |                  | A place where the product does something the target does not want.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Field     | Description            | `field.divergence.description`  | text             | What the product does instead, and the ticket or decision that will settle it.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Relation  | Concepts               | `edge.divergence.concepts`      | refs ent.concept | The concepts involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Only contradictions    | `rule.divergence-contradicts`   |                  | A divergence records behavior that contradicts the target; what is not built yet is the gap, not a divergence.                                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | Becomes work           | `rule.divergence-becomes-work`  |                  | Each divergence becomes a ticket, or a decision when the target was what changed.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Rule      | Second vocabulary      | `rule.second-vocabulary`        |                  | A project may keep the vocabulary of what shipped apart from the target's; where they disagree, it is a divergence, never a silent edit of either.                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Concepts named         | `inv.divergence-names-concepts` |                  | Every line under known divergences names at least one concept by ID.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Action    | Walk the product blind | `action.walk-blind`             |                  | Use the product as a user, from the ontology, the catalogue, the map and the run guides but not the code: behavior that contradicts the target becomes a known divergence, a case the catalogue lacks becomes a check, and what is not built is already the gap. |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                                 | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                | WHEN                        | THEN                                                                                                                                                             | Proof  |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.divergence.no-concept`          | `inv.divergence-names-concepts`                          | a line under known divergences names no concept by ID                                                                                                | the check runs              | it quotes the line and fails                                                                                                                                     | auto   |
| `check.divergence.walk-blind`          | `action.walk-blind`                                      | a blind walk found that renewal goes through while someone waits, that the hold queue is not served, and that nothing says what a damaged item shows | a reviewer reads its report | the walker had no access to the code; the renewal became a known divergence, the case of the damaged item a check, and the queue nothing new, since it is target | review |
| `check.divergence.only-contradictions` | `rule.divergence-contradicts`                            | a new line under known divergences                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads it         | it describes behavior that contradicts the target, not something missing                                                                                         | review |
| `check.divergence.becomes-work`        | `rule.divergence-becomes-work`, `rule.second-vocabulary` | a known divergence                                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads the list   | it points at a ticket or a pending decision, and neither side was edited to hide it                                                                              | review |

| `check.mockup-element.fictional-data`           | `rule.mockup-data-fictional`                  | a mockup shared outside the team                                       | a reviewer reads its data                                           | it holds no real names or records                                                     | review |

## Check

| Kind      | Term                        | ID                              | Type                             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Check                       | `ent.check`                     |                                  | A case with data that must hold for any implementation, in the product's terms.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Field     | GIVEN                       | `field.check.given`             | text                             | The state to start from.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field     | WHEN                        | `field.check.when`              | text                             | The event.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Field     | THEN                        | `field.check.then`              | text                             | The observable result.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Proof                       | `field.check.proof`             | one of auto, judged, review, run | auto when a test implements it, judged when a test runs it and a model judges the output against its THEN, review when a reviewer of another provider gives it a verdict reading the change before merge, run when an agent runs it on the working product, in the mockup or blind, or a person where the project chooses so. auto and judged checks are automatic; review and run have no test, and a record of a verdict says who carried each out. |
| Relation  | Proves                      | `edge.check.concepts`           | refs ent.concept                 | The concepts the check proves.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Concept   | Ontology layer              | `concept.ontology-layer`        |                                  | What the tool checks in any project: the ontology and the artifacts that refer to it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Concept   | Product layer               | `concept.product-layer`         |                                  | What a project's catalogue and tests check: the product that agents build from the ontology.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Concept   | Completeness axis           | `concept.completeness-axis`     |                                  | A fork along which behavior diverges, with its values. Every action has the outcome axis: success, refusal, empty, error, silence; a project may add axes of its own.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | In the product's terms      | `rule.check-in-product-terms`   |                                  | GIVEN, WHEN and THEN use concrete data from a fixed sample and the product's words; no function names, commands or selectors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Rule      | Unreachable reported        | `rule.unreachable-reported`     |                                  | A check of review or run that could not be carried out is reported as not run, never verified through another path.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | Evidence kept               | `rule.manual-evidence-kept`     |                                  | Evidence of a check of review or run is kept outside the repository, named by check and date.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Rule      | Chosen values checked       | `rule.chosen-value-checked`     |                                  | A value a decision chose, or a target that is a requirement, is held by an automatic check; a model's assumptions are held by a snapshot of its base scenario's results, never by a check that the model reaches its goal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Rule      | The judge sees the check    | `rule.judge-sees-the-check`     |                                  | A judge gets the check's GIVEN, WHEN and THEN and the product's output, not the code or the test.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Rule      | Verdict kept                | `rule.verdict-kept`             |                                  | The verdict of a judged check is kept outside the repository, named by check and date, like the evidence of a check of review or run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | Each state of a view judged | `rule.view-state-judged`        |                                  | Every state of an implemented view that the view's note describes has a judged check: in that state, a snapshot of the view shows what the note says for it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Screens kept                | `rule.screens-kept`             |                                  | A run of a view's judged checks keeps the snapshot of each screen, and its image where the product can take one, outside the repository, named by the view, the state and the date, so that the owner judges layout and style on them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Rule      | No redundant check          | `rule.check-not-redundant`      |                                  | Two checks whose cases differ only in data, not in behavior, are one: a check whose removal loses no value or combination of values that the others cover goes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Invariant | Unique                      | `inv.check-ids-unique`          |                                  | No check ID is used twice.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | In its section              | `inv.check-in-its-section`      |                                  | A check's ID names the key of the catalogue section it sits in: the code span in the heading, or else the heading's Latin letters and digits in lowercase.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | Well formed                 | `inv.check-well-formed`         |                                  | A check has concepts, GIVEN, WHEN, THEN and a proof: auto, judged, review or run; the earlier proof manual, of a catalogue not yet moved, is read as before and named with what replaces it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Invariant | Checks before code          | `inv.required-concepts-checked` |                                  | Every concept of a required class has a check, built or not.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Invariant | Automatic checks tested     | `inv.auto-check-tested`         |                                  | Every automatic check whose concepts are all implemented has a test.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Invariant | Section keys match          | `inv.section-keys-match`        |                                  | Each ontology section with definition rows has a key of its own, every catalogue section's key names one of them, and a key written in a heading is one code span of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Judged checks tested        | `inv.judged-check-tested`       |                                  | Every judged check whose concepts are all implemented has a test that runs it with a judge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Every axis value covered    | `inv.axis-values-covered`       |                                  | Every value of every axis is covered by a check, the outcome axis by each action's own checks, unless the catalogue says why the value cannot occur.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Action    | Derive blind                | `action.derive-blind`           |                                  | Someone who sees only the ontology and the catalogue says what should happen in a case the catalogue does not hold; a mismatch with the owner's answer adds a check, or an open question when the owner does not know.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

## Verdict record `manual-run`

| Kind      | Term                                      | ID                             | Type                                       | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Verdict record                            | `ent.manual-run`               |                                            | A record of a verdict on a check of review or run: one file in the directory the configuration names under verdicts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Field     | Time                                      | `field.manual-run.time`        | datetime                                   | When the verdict was given, in UTC to the second; it orders the records of a check.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Field     | Commit                                    | `field.manual-run.commit`      | text                                       | The commit or the range of commits the verdict was given on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Stamp                                     | `field.manual-run.stamp`       | text                                       | The stamp of the check's case, its proof and its concepts when the verdict was given, as --review prints it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Verdict                                   | `field.manual-run.verdict`     | one of pass, fail, not-run, not-applicable | What the verdict found; not-run and not-applicable say why the check was not carried out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Field     | By                                        | `field.manual-run.by`          | text                                       | Who gave the verdict: the reviewer, a model and its provider, or a person; one value for every record of a review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Field     | Performer                                 | `field.manual-run.performer`   | one of code, model, agent, person optional | Who carried the check out, on a pass or a fail only: agent by default, person when the project gave the run to a person and the reviewer passes the result on, whose name is then in the evidence. A record without it is read as before.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Field     | Evidence                                  | `field.manual-run.evidence`    | text optional                              | Where the evidence is, outside the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field     | Origin                                    | `field.manual-run.origin`      | one of review, run optional                | Who wrote the record: review, the reviewer's verdict by --review --record, or run, a run of a check of run outside a review by --run-record; a record without the line is the reviewer's, as before.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Field     | Class                                     | `field.manual-run.class`       | text optional                              | On a fail, the classes of problem of its findings, separated by  · , as the reviewer names them, each in square brackets at the start of the evidence of the table's row; --record refuses a fail without one, and a not-run or a not-applicable without its reason in the evidence (D-187).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Field     | Carried                                   | `field.manual-run.carried`     | text optional                              | The record a carried verdict carries: --record writes a record of its own for each carry it checked, on the checked commit, with the carried record's verdict and class, so that a verdict of an earlier result reaches the checked commit only by a carry the writer checked (D-187). A carried not-run or not-applicable has the reason of the record it carries, followed through carries, never the carry's own evidence, which is its citation: the writer refuses the carry of one that gives none of its own. The check of errors in code and the check of the analysis of the cause are never carried; the writer refuses their carry, and a record of either with Carried: is no verdict of it to any reader (D-192).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Field     | Base                                      | `field.manual-run.base`        | text optional                              | The commit the diff of the review starts from, the base given to --review, which --record writes on each record: the one issue of verdicts after the narrow round is held only by records whose base is the narrow round's commit, verdicts given on its own diff (rule.one-issue-after-narrow, D-187).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Relation  | Check                                     | `edge.manual-run.check`        | ref ent.check                              | The check the verdict is on, from the project's catalogue or the approach's.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Derived   | Current record                            | `derived.current-run`          |                                            | The latest record of a check, by time and then by file name, whose verdict is pass or fail and whose stamp is the check's stamp now, or, for a record given in the range of fixes after a narrow round, a stamp a fix of the range changed (rule.fixes-held-by-tests). A record of a run outside a review, Origin: run, is current only while no file outside the directories of records of the process, of rounds, of verdicts and of task records, has changed since its commit, in a commit or in the working copy (D-171).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Rule      | Run recorded                              | `rule.run-recorded`            |                                            | Every verdict of a review is recorded as a verdict record, and the record links to the evidence, which stays outside the repository.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule      | Records in English, inside the repository | `rule.records-english-in-repo` |                                            | A verdict record or a record of a round of review holds no path outside the repository: no absolute path, and no path that leaves it by ..; a URL of the web is allowed, and what is kept outside the repository is named in words. Where the configuration sets records.latinOnly, its text holds Latin letters only, a project's rule of language; there a record of a gate change or of a gate proof is held to both, while a record of the directory of task records of another kind, spend, done or approval, is read as it was before these kinds came, with no rule of language, but for the evidence of a record of done, which no earlier record carries, held to both (field.task-result.evidence, D-166).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Invariant | Review and run checks recorded            | `inv.manual-checks-run`        |                                            | When the configuration sets verdicts.require, every check of review or run of implemented concepts, and one whose proof is the earlier manual, has a current record, pass or fail.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Invariant | Records well formed                       | `inv.manual-runs-well-formed`  |                                            | Every record gives once each a known check, one of the catalogue, of the approach's or one the Retired IDs table retires, whose records are then history and never current, a verdict, a real time in UTC, a commit, a stamp, an author and, when it gives one, a performer of the four on a pass or a fail, with evidence when it is person, its file name is its time and check, and no two records share the check, the time and the author. A record that gives Origin: gives review or run, and one of run names a commit, never a working tree.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Action    | Record the verdicts                       | `action.record-verdicts`       |                                            | Write the records of a review from the reviewer's table of verdicts: one record for each new verdict, with the stamp and the commit --review gives, and on a pass or a fail a performer, agent unless the row names another; a verdict of the table is written as the record writes it, or with a space, not run and not applicable, and a pipe in its evidence is escaped with a backslash; a verdict carried from an earlier round names the record it carries, one --record wrote with any performer or none, and the files read for it, and writes none. The table is refused when it names a check the review does not list or names one twice, when a listed check has neither a new verdict nor a carried one, when a row names a performer that is not one of the four or names one on a verdict other than pass or fail, or names person without the evidence that names the person, when a carried record is not of that check or its stamp is not the check's stamp now, when a carried verdict names no files, was given on uncommitted changes or one of its files changed since the record's commit, and when the check of errors in code is carried. Each record is written with its seal and Origin: review (D-167, D-171). |
| Action    | Start a run outside a review              | `action.start-run`             |                                            | ont-check --run-start <check>, before the run of a check of run: keeps HEAD in the Git directory of the working copy and refuses a working copy that differs from it outside the directories of records of the process.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Action    | Record a run outside a review             | `action.record-run`            |                                            | ont-check --run-record <check> --verdict pass --performer … --by … --evidence …, or --verdict fail, after the run: refuses when anything outside the directories of records of the process changed since the HEAD of --run-start, in a commit or in the working copy, and writes the verdict record with that commit, the check's stamp now, Performer: who carried it out, By: who gave the verdict, Origin: run and its seal; --review carries it as the reviewer's verdict only when its stamp is the check's, its commit is committed, no file outside those directories changed between it and the head of the review and the working copy outside them is that head.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

a round that gives it; (5) acceptance refused: one with no finding in either verdict whose verdict of acceptance is refused by inv.acceptance-after-done; a round whose verdict holds; (6) clean: the last round ends the step; the step ends, a round of the review of the result ending the task even past the budget; (7) stagnation: the last round has an important finding and either an important class of it was an important finding of an earlier round of the step or it has no fewer important classes than the round before it; the next is a short analysis of the cause, then a full round: for a repeated class, naming the repeated classes, why the earlier fix did not hold and the one cause behind it; for no fewer important classes and no repeat, why the round found no fewer; by the analysis, the design is changed where the cause lies when it lies in the design, the error is fixed otherwise, and a rare case is filed as rule.findings-filed files a finding; the executor gives the analysis to round.mjs brief (action.brief-round); (8) next round: another round, narrow when every finding of the last round is fixed with a test and full when not. The end of the step, defined here once, which derived.task-next, the comparison of rounds, rule.ready-after-clean-round, the check and the round that would end a task read and none restates: a round ends its step when it has no finding of the change, of either weight, that is not filed, a finding that was there before the change counting never, and, on the review of the result, a verdict Acceptance: clean that holds, for the last round for the latest record of done, for an earlier round by the records as they were when it was given and for the version that round read, never against a statement given later; a clean round, the round C and the one round after it end the step alike, and after C the step ends also by the record of done that ends the range of fixes, as branch 3 says (rule.fixes-held-by-tests). The budget is no branch of a step: derived.task-next alone orders it, before an open gate. Rounds are compared only after the last end of the step, or the owner's last record of approval for the task (ent.owner-approval), before which no round of the step is read by these branches; the first round with findings after it is not stagnation. A finding not fixable in a round whose time is before the configuration's reviewRounds.gatesFrom carries the meaning it had before D-152, not fixable within the task: it opens no gate over the task and is a question at that round only, when it is the last of its step; without the key every round carries the meaning of D-152. Only important findings of the change count in the comparison, never nits, findings not fixable nor findings filed (rule.findings-filed, rule.executor-triage). A next round takes the next free number of its kind over every round of the step. When a record of the directory of rounds cannot be read, of this task, of another or of none, or a record is late, as derived.task-next says, the one next action of every task is to correct it. --task, --rounds and the check give it by one function, so they name one next action for every history, and --task and --rounds name it on the line NEXT <task>: alone, as derived.task-next says, every other line saying a state. |

| Rule      | Findings filed                    | `rule.findings-filed`               |                                        | A finding the executor marks a rare history (rule.executor-triage) is filed in place of fixable: one of what the approach does not do by choice in the project's limitations, docs/limitations.md, with the value limitation, and a fault of the tool or a finding outside the approved statement in a ticket under issues/, with the value later; the last field of the line names the file, which, every symbolic link on its path followed, is in the repository and holds the finding's class word for word, or the record cannot be read. | Rule      | Executor's triage                 | `rule.executor-triage`              |                                        | Before any fix, the executor marks every finding of a round, important or nit, usual path, when it breaks the goal's condition on the usual path, or a rare history. A finding is usual path only when the executor names the concrete step of usual work it breaks; otherwise it is a rare history; the step named is written in the notes of the round's record next to the finding, and the tool does not read it. A rare history is filed by rule.findings-filed, limitation or later in place of fixable, with its file, in the commit of the round's record; a finding of acceptance, an item of the approved statement not met, is never filed, and a nit is fixed or filed like any finding. The reviewer marks each finding usual or rare as advice, which blocks nothing: the executor decides, either way, and writes the weight and the filing on the finding's line of the record, which the tool reads. A filed finding counts neither in the comparison of rounds nor in stagnation, so stagnation, and the analysis of its cause, follows from findings of the usual path alone. Once the reviewer of the result has confirmed the goal's condition, the step either ends at that round, by the one end of a step of derived.next-round, or one round alone follows, narrow, and when that round does not end the step no round and no question follow it: its findings are fixed with tests by rule.fixes-held-by-tests. | Rule      | Fixes held by tests               | `rule.fixes-held-by-tests`          |                                        | After the reviewer of the result has confirmed the goal's condition and the one narrow round after it has not ended the step (derived.next-round), the commits of the range of fixes need no new round, no new acceptance, no new verdict, no current stamp and no unchanged files read, and they pass the confirmation that only records follow the reviewed commit (rule.merge-what-was-checked); a fail or a finding closed so holds no merge. The range rests only on records that exist: it starts after the commit the narrow round reviewed, the last of its Commits:, and ends at the commit of the first record of done of the window after the narrow round on another commit, its Commit:, or, while there is none, at the head of the working copy, for done.mjs the commit it records done on; commits after that record of done are outside it. It holds the fixes of the findings of the usual path of the narrow round, those of its verdict of acceptance included, each closed by a test; the one issue of verdicts on the diff of the fixes, --review from the narrow round's commit with --record, which is no round, the check of errors in code given once there; the fixes of the findings of the usual path of that issue, its fails and the findings its reviewer reports by the change-review skill, each closed by a test with no new issue; and the filings of the rare findings of both, which outside the records change only docs/limitations.md and issues/, a finding of the usual path never being filed. The confirmation that only records follow compares, on this path, with the commit of the record of done that ends the range, and without one with the commit the reviewer checked, never with the head. One function of the tool gives the range and its end, alike for every place that checks these requirements: --task, --rounds, done.mjs, --review, the check's current records and merge-gate.mjs records-only. Whether the issue was given and whether each fix has a test of its own and runs it, the tool does not see (docs/limitations.md). At the merge the guard reads them in the window of the step the merged result ended, from the end before it up to the round that ended it, or to the record of done that ended its range: a fail in it whose classes the round that ended the step did not file, the narrow round when the record of done of its range ended it, and no record of fixes held with a test or filed, holds the merge, VERDICT_FAILED, the closing round being clean or not, since a filing of an earlier round of the window waives no later fail, as in rule.verdicts-hold-merge; a verdict of a window that ended earlier holds no new result. A fail of the analysis of the cause is decided only when the latest verdict of that check after it in the same window, of a later round or of the one issue, is a pass given on the corrected analysis: while there is none, the brief of each next round carries Cause:, and after the last narrow round the one issue of verdicts gives it, its record naming the hash of the corrected analysis; a later fail, a not-run or a not-applicable, of the issue too, or an issue without that check leaves it failed (D-188). The writer of the next brief and the guard derive it by one function from the records, so that what one holds the other holds; it reads only verdicts given, never a carry, so that a pass given on another analysis never reaches the round whose Cause: it would decide (D-191, D-192).
